Legacy

Bush's legacy continues to develop, as time allows the development of a more nuanced historical perspective.

Critics point to his handling of the Iraq War , specifically the failure to find weapons of mass destruction after claiming they were in Iraq, as well as Bush's handling of tax policy , Hurricane Katrina , climate change and the 2008 financial crisis , as proof he was unfit to be president.
